# Underwings Cybersecurity Solutions

> UAE-based cybersecurity services company. Offensive security, cloud security, network & infrastructure, GRC (ISO 27001 / NESA / PDPL), and training & awareness. Services delivered by named, certified practitioners (OSCP, CPTS, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CCNP, Security+, Azure Security).

Contact: contact@underwings.org
Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

## Services

- [Offensive Security](https://underwings.org/services/offensive-security): Network and web application penetration testing, phishing simulation, vulnerability assessment. OSCP / CPTS certified. Manual testing, not vuln-scan PDFs.
- [Cloud Security](https://underwings.org/services/cloud-security): Azure and Microsoft 365 security assessments against CIS benchmarks. Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender posture.
- [Network & Infrastructure](https://underwings.org/services/network-infrastructure): FortiGate firewall reviews, network segmentation, security architecture design. CCNP + Fortinet + OSCP led.
- [GRC](https://underwings.org/services/grc): ISO 27001:2022 gap assessment and implementation, NESA / UAE IA V2, UAE PDPL advisory, ISO 27005 risk register build. Led by ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.
- [Training & Awareness](https://underwings.org/services/training-awareness): Security awareness training workshops and tabletop incident response exercises led by OSCP-certified pen-testers.
